anchors.content: The renew_lease path in memory_gateway/db.py must validate lease_until against worker ownership before extending a lease; otherwise an expired worker can renew another worker's job.
The selector response contract uses a per-chunk enum in tests/test_openai_adapter.py so selector_chunk_index stays within the current chunk instead of using the old static schema.
promote_capsule_cas is the only active-capsule write: it checks lineage and stale_revision before compare-and-swap promotion, leaving compaction_jobs and ACTIVE consistent.
SQLite retrieval can raise sqlite3.OperationalError while a writer holds the database; bounded busy_timeout_ms and a fail-open response keep the hot context available.
RETIRE semantic memories retain memory_evidence links to the immutable event_id history; a semantic row never replaces the authoritative raw evidence.
cold_memory_token_budget and context_budget_tokens leave current user instructions, ACTIVE, and the raw tail ahead of would_inject cold memories; Phase 1 allows at most three memories.
The FTS progress_handler enforces a retrieval deadline; a TimeoutError records bounded telemetry and returns no cold context without appending an event or mutating the capsule.
On Windows, taskkill.exe is used for deterministic process cleanup after savedRigSoak imports; profile cleanup is verified before the next real browser run.
The recent raw tail remains protected verbatim context and is assembled independently from the ACTIVE capsule and optional cold retrieval sidecar.
RETIRE persistence occurs only after successful ACTIVE promotion; a cold sidecar write failure cannot turn a valid hot promotion into a failed compaction job.
Retrieved memories are ephemeral assembly context, not events: shadow mode records would_inject candidates but does not insert a COLD RETRIEVED MEMORY message into the outbound hot context.
Phase 1 builds a deterministic retrieval query from the current user message, latest tool result, ACTIVE content, file paths, and symbol names; no LLM is in the retrieval critical path.
SQLite FTS5 searches only ACTIVE long_term_memories scoped by project_id and thread_id; provenance remains in memory_evidence.
Protocol hardening keeps the dynamic per-chunk selector enum; an old test expecting SELECTOR_RESPONSE_FORMAT is not a cold-memory regression.
